stem: Which quotation foreshadows the ultimate decision to allow the boy to use the name “Gogol” at school instead of “Nikhil”?

options.label: A
options.text: Though Mrs. Lapidus does not understand a word, she listens carefully, hears that name again. Gogol. Lightly, in pencil, she writes it down on the registration form.

options.label: B
options.text: Gogol looks down at his sneakers. The way the principal pronounces his new name is different from the way his parents say it, the second part of it longer, sounding like “heel.”

options.label: C
options.text: She bends down so that her face is level with his, and extends a hand to his shoulder. "Can you tell me how old you are, Nikhil?"

options.label: D
options.text: He thanks Mrs. Lapidus. "Be good, Nikhil," he says in English. And then, after a moment’s hesitation, he is gone.
